scope: Independent source, formula and actual raw-format metadata review only; no population/dipole analysis execution.

material_findings.issue: Actual native electric origins differ between fragments.
material_findings.evidence: For W9Dy: original complex (0,0,0.269042), water1 metal-water (0.453238,0,0.169344), water-only (4.541563,0,1.696875), isolated metal (0,0,0), under Center of mass origin labels.
material_findings.impact: Direct combination of charged total/electronic/nuclear dipoles from different origins is invalid. Nuclear-cancellation gate should fail; neutral combined charge alone does not repair noncommon origins.
material_findings.required_change: Transform each dipole to one common origin with checked native units, electron/nuclear charge and propagated printed-origin rounding, or explicitly hold dipole results unavailable while completing population-only analysis.

material_findings.issue: Independent admission and inventory are not fully joined.
material_findings.required_change: Check passed independent-review status and its exact collector_result identity; require full exact80 expected source IDs and per-row complete status.

material_findings.issue: Parsing failure exits after output-directory creation without a structured failure/cost record.
material_findings.required_change: Preserve a terminal failure receipt with source/config, error and elapsed/CPU cost; never substitute a population or dipole value.

correct_as_written: C=complex-ion-shell; P=sum(dimers)-Nion-sum(waters); B=C-P with expanded ion coefficientN-1.
All ghost center charges are retained, with exact indexed labels and full parent atom count.
Positive B on the metal means less full-shell electron-population gain than additive pairs, under that population convention.
No claim that partition-dependent charges uniquely identify charge transfer or an energy component.

roundoff_review.conclusion: Population reconstruction tolerances cover worst-case six-decimal printing. Nine-decimal dipole component closure5e-9 covers three-vector rounding; origin correction needs its own propagated bound.
